audit lens.cite: a fresh Claude QA context in its own worktree
audit lens.reply_head:
No
The proposal mandates AI seats using "fresh context," a state git cannot verify. Git records commits and file content but cannot prove model isolation, context initialization, or the absence of prior state reuse. This creates a loophole where the team could claim compliance while reusing contexts, undermining the independent review and audit integrity. The practice relies on unverifiable promises.
Condition: The proposal must require a git-verifiable artifact, such as a context hash or initialization log committed by each seat, to prove context freshness and isolation.
